outcome: Incidence of preeclampsia with severe features
cohort: 2069 women undergoing fresh in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection and frozen embryo transfer cycles
finding: In vitro fertilization, obstetrical, and neonatal outcomes were largely comparable across BMI groups, except for a higher risk of preeclampsia with severe features in the BMI ≥50 kg/m(2) group.
